paragraphs: R. Chiyya of Kefar Techumin and R. Berekhiah: Peah, chapter 1. Before Rav, in Jerusalem Terumot at the end of chapter 11. That matter in Shabbat, chapter 2, halakhah 1, is before Rabbi and R. Abbahu.
